pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Question: Will the pedestrian located at [539, 717, 658, 1040] in frame 1 cross the road? Justify your answer with spatial, temporal, mathematical, ego-vehicle, and scene-context reasoning. Conclude the pedestrian’s motives.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Temporal_Reason: Throughout all observed frames, the pedestrian shows no preparatory crossing behaviors such as stepping forward toward the road, pausing at the curb, or shifting their body orientation toward the street.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Scene_Context_Reason: The commercial area has no visible crosswalk markings or traffic signals, the pedestrian remains on the sidewalk between parked cars, and their consistent parallel movement indicates they are simply walking along the street rather than seeking a crossing opportunity.
pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Conclusion: The pedestrian is walking along the sidewalk parallel to the road without showing any crossing preparation behaviors, body orientation toward the street, or response to the approaching vehicle, making it highly unlikely they will cross.
